name: catalyst_open_world_enzymarc_v1
purpose: Quantify open-world catalytic-integrity rejection on externally generated high-homology non-functional enzyme decoys, complementing future-association retrieval metrics.

external_source.name: EnzymARC
external_source.paper: A novel benchmark dataset for enzyme function prediction reveals the limitations of state-of-the-art models

task_adapter.unit: parent enzyme / annotated Rhea reaction / generated decoy sequence
task_adapter.inclusion: retain a parent only when its annotated Rhea reaction maps exactly to the frozen Catalyst reaction registry and the parent relation has an unambiguous protein sequence; retain every released decoy category for that parent without performance-based filtering
task_adapter.score: raw reaction-to-protein compatibility from the already frozen Catalyst R2E scorer; no EnzymARC-specific training, threshold tuning, reranking, or feature adaptation
task_adapter.primary_pairwise_question: does the functional parent score strictly above its matched decoy for the same reaction?
task_adapter.production_source_score: Use results/catalyst_clean_mainline_v1/r2e_center_bounded_cap0p1 (ESM-C 1152-d primary source + frozen bounded reaction-center residual). Every retained target reaction is a clean2023 training reaction, hence exact train DRFP similarity is 1.0 and this is the high-similarity source expert of the confirmed production similarity router.
task_adapter.lambdarank_boundary: terpene-production-routes-v4 LambdaRank explicitly excludes temporary candidates. EnzymARC decoys are temporary out-of-registry sequences, so no synthetic LambdaRank pair score is fabricated; the benchmark measures the frozen primary source compatibility named above.
task_adapter.cohort: all mapped support rows whose parent passes the frozen sequence_form_gate; no performance-based sampling or filtering. One parent/category decoy sequence is joined to every exact clean2023 Rhea relation of that parent.
task_adapter.parent_score: score the original clean2023 parent sequence against the identical target reaction with the same frozen source scorer.
task_adapter.decoy_score: score each released EnzymARC decoy sequence against each exact clean2023 target reaction of its parent.

reporting.bootstrap: 1000 deterministic parent-clustered bootstrap replicates, seed 20260902; resample parent accessions with replacement and include all their relations/categories in each replicate.
reporting.bootstrap_other_metrics: full-support point estimates only; no post-score choice of bootstrap metric

baselines.classical_same_task: historical association transfer: max over clean2023 proteins annotated to the target reaction of MMseqs2 sequence identity(candidate, historical_positive); evaluate the identical parent-vs-decoy metrics
baselines.author_native_boundary: Author EC-retention false-positive rates are contextual because their task is EC classification, not Catalyst reaction-pair compatibility; do not fabricate direct deltas between incomparable metrics.
baselines.classical_same_task_detail: For each target reaction, use only clean2023 annotated proteins. Parent and decoy are searched with MMseqs2 against this frozen target set; baseline score is maximum reported sequence identity among proteins annotated to that reaction. Same MMseqs2 parameters for parent and decoy; no EnzymARC-dependent threshold tuning.

promotion_or_selection.if_current_system_is_weak: record the weakness and design a separately preregistered open-world integrity mechanism on different development evidence; EnzymARC remains external confirmation only

metrics_definition.paired_parent_win_rate: mean(parent_score > decoy_score) over relation/category pair instances; strict ties are losses
metrics_definition.parent_vs_decoy_AUROC: binary AUROC on the paired-instance multiset containing one duplicated parent score with label 1 and its matched decoy score with label 0 for every relation/category instance
metrics_definition.decoy_score_retention_ratio_median: median((decoy_score + 1)/(parent_score + 1)); frozen source scores are cosine-like in [-1,1], and denominator is clipped to at least 1e-8 for numerical safety

sequence_form_gate.purpose: exclude accession matches whose clean2023 sequence form is not the parent sequence form used to generate EnzymARC decoys; this is input-support QC before any Catalyst or baseline score
sequence_form_gate.search: easy-search catalytic-residue decoys against the mapped clean2023 parent FASTA; sensitivity 7.5; max-seqs 500; no identity or coverage prefilter; 16 threads
sequence_form_gate.matched_pair: query accession must align to target with the identical accession
sequence_form_gate.eligibility: matched alignment fractional identity >=0.80 AND query coverage >=0.80 AND target coverage >=0.80
sequence_form_gate.missing_matched_hit: exclude parent and every decoy category for that parent

active_decision: Do not spend project time encoding/scoring 236k+ external decoys while complete lower-cost retrieval benchmarks already exist. Retain the frozen support/sequence-form audits only; reactivate only if a competition deliverable specifically needs catalytic-integrity decoys.
